hooks.command: grep -n 'collect()\|toPandas()\|\.show()' "$FILE" && echo '⚠ Spark anti-pattern detected: collect()/toPandas()/show() found. Consider using take(), limit(), or write operations instead.' || true

echo "$CONTENT" | grep -iE '(password|secret|api_key|access_key|connection_string)\s*=\s*["'\'']((?!\{\{|\$|os\.environ|getenv).)+["'\'']]' && echo '🚨 Potential secret detected in file. Use environment variables or Key Vault instead.' && exit 1 || true

git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | grep '\.py$' | xargs grep -l 'print(' 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo '⚠ print() statements found in modified Python files. Use logger instead.' || true
hooks.description: Check for print() in modified Python files (use logger instead)
